notes.title: The game will retire
notes.notes: [p]Unfortunately, we won't be able to continue supporting the game. It will soon retire.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for the support, and we apologize for the inconvenience.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Seduction Has Been Updated!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello![/b]

[b]We've made some improvements and bug fixes to the game.

List of changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Oculus support is now working as intended
[*]Added music and ambient sounds to all stages
[*]Fixed orb picking bug
[*]Fixed girls sounds on Oculus
[*]Fixed problem with menu button on few stages
[*]Other minor bug fixes
[/list]

[b]Thank you for all your support![/b]

notes.title: Oculus Support
notes.notes:
[b]We are aware of the problem on Oculus Rift with Touch controllers.[/b]

[h1]Until we resolve it, here is temporary fix:[/h1]

[b]Change Seduction file to Windows 7 compatibility mode (picture below).[/b]
To do so, locate the game .exe file on your computer, usually it looks something like this: 
Local Disk (D:)/Steam/steamapps/common/Seduction

Press right mouse button on it and select [b]Properties[/b].

Choose [b]Compatibility[/b] tab

Check the box next to [b]'Run this program in compatibility mode for:'[/b] and select [b]Windows 7[/b] below.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29536820/8c9a10709bbbf906ce765f7ddd598513a855dbf9.jpg[/img]

We will fix it as soon as possible. Sorry for the inconvenience.
